Injection Attack

Log off immediately after using a web application. Clear History after using a web application, and don't allow your browser to save your login details.

CSRF Attack

Correct Answer:
Secure remote administration and connectivity testing. Perform extensive input validation. Configure the firewall to deny ICMP traffic. Stop data processed by the attacker from being executed.

Incorrect Answer:
Injection Attack

Correct Answer:
DoS Attack

Update web servers with security patches on a regular basis. Limit access to the secure areas of the website.

Directory Traversal

Correct Answer:
Explanation
To guard against cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, use rigid specifications to validate all headers, cookie query strings, hidden fields, and form fields.

To guard against injection attacks, perform input validation. Do not permit dangerous characters in the input.

To guard against cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks, log off immediately after using a web application. Clear History after using a web application, and don't allow your browser to save your login details.

To guard against denial-of-service (DoS) attacks, secure remote administration and connectivity testing. Perform extensive input validation. Configure the firewall to deny ICMP traffic. Stop data processed by the attacker from being executed.

To guard against directory traversal attacks, update web servers with security patches on a regular basis. Limit access to the secure areas of the website.
